description: Salesforce's hosted MCP server (Beta): discover, describe, and dispatch Salesforce APIs and Setup Operation Recipes. Uses per-user egress OAuth (PKCE): each user connects their own Salesforce account once, the gateway vaults the user token and injects it on egress. Calls execute as the signed-in user, honoring field-level security, sharing rules, and permission sets. Configure egress OAuth separately after registration via POST /servers/salesforce-headless-360/egress-auth (egress_provider=custom, with your org's authorize/token URLs). Set append_mcp_path=false: this endpoint serves JSON-RPC at its root and 404s on /mcp.
